title: Basis conjecture for the box-kernel relations
statement: For positive integers $z,d$ with $z\leq d$, let $\mathcal{K}_{z,d}$ and $\operatorname{Box}_{z,d}$ be as defined in the source. **Basis conjecture.** If $z\leq d$, then $\mathcal{K}_{z,d}$ is a basis of $\operatorname{ker}\operatorname{Box}_{z,d}$. This refines the box-kernel conjecture by asserting linear independence as well as spanning; the paper gives no proof in general.
source_name: Benjamin Brindle, “On the structure of Multiple q-Zeta Values”, arXiv:2511.07302 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.07302

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2025).
